recognize_zh: 20倍下周邊血液白血球明顯增多，多為核雙葉的不成熟細胞，同時可見多處紅血球成團聚集（agglutination），提示APL高白血球血症合併自體免疫性溶血。
features: Hyperleukocytosis with numerous medium to large mononuclear cells, many with bilobed nuclei
Multiple irregular clumps of agglutinated red cells scattered across the field
Remaining red cells show crenation and anisocytosis
A few smaller mature lymphocytes/neutrophils admixed
Magnification too low to assess granules or Auer rods
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate magnification shows marked leukocytosis composed mainly of medium to large immature cells, many with bilobed nuclei, consistent with abnormal promyelocytes. Numerous irregular clumps of agglutinated red cells are distributed throughout the smear. Granules and Auer rods cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with microgranular acute promyelocytic leukemia with hyperleukocytosis and red cell agglutination, suggestive of an associated autoimmune hemolytic process (direct antiglobulin test recommended).

ddx.vs: Cold agglutinin disease shows similar red cell clumping that disperses on warming but lacks a leukemic population of abnormal promyelocytes.
Rouleaux are linear 'stack of coins' arrangements seen with increased plasma proteins, whereas agglutinates are irregular three-dimensional clumps.
Monocytic blasts lack bilobed promyelocyte morphology and are HLA-DR positive and PML-RARA negative.
